x: Black and Redmond had already done their business, John gave the baton to wily Kris Akabusi, cast in the unusual role of anchor man, and he stole it from the US on the line.

Roger Black and Derek Redmond have done their work well and now it is up to John Regis to keep breathing down the neck of the USA's Danny Everett. The Belgravian does a fine job, leaving Kris Akabusi to wait ... and wait ... and then strike for gold in the last two metres.

John Regis and Marcus Adam have now put themselves under the wing of Mike Whittingham, coach to Roger Black and Kris Akabusi, so it will be interesting to see what effect this change will make to their fortunes during the coming season.
